name: glimpse
description: Glimpse: a webcam maths tutor. Web app (web/), engine (server/), decision model Laya (decide/).

scripts.setup:decide: python3.15 -m venv decide/.venv || python3 -m venv decide/.venv; decide/.venv/bin/pip install -r decide/requirements.txt
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n engine,glimpse,decide -c blue,magenta,yellow "node --watch server/index.js" "GLIMPSE_ENGINE=http://localhost:3001 npm --prefix web run dev" "node scripts/start-decide.js"
scripts.start: npm --prefix web run build && node server/index.js
